removed_component: explicit observe_goal tool and active-state goal wrapper
reason: The wrapper duplicated the public goal already available to the Agent, still required an Agent decision to invoke it, and therefore did not guarantee earlier feasibility detection.
retained_algorithm: the continuous Agent calls the existing clean-replay tool as soon as it believes a complete program is feasible
a clean-replay Pass stores the canonical program and certificate as the latest incumbent
the Agent may continue same-session quality improvement
only a later clean-replay Pass replaces the incumbent
provider failure or a request/wall safety cap selects the latest incumbent
